purpose: Prove the PACK_VALIDATION-owned path from already-authorized exact-head input through affected-pack discovery, pack-local deterministic validation, bounded evidence, and final PASS/FAIL without invoking or owning foreign controls.

live_wiring_probe.source: exact-head Validate LF Packs run on the rebind candidate
required_observations: canonical Pack Validation flow step executes successfully
bounded Pack Validation artifact is emitted
no runtime, Git-write, DB-write, deployment, or production authorization is granted
live_wiring_probe.note: A non-pack rebind diff may legitimately produce SKIP; this proves caller wiring but not positive pack execution.

positive_pack_probe.fixture: one synthetic governed SKILL_PACK with validators/validate_pack.py returning zero

negative_pack_probe.fixture: one synthetic governed SKILL_PACK whose local validator returns non-zero

foreign_work_forbidden: Contract Check repair or admission change
S30 broker or protected Git write
completion_rule: PASS only when the live wiring probe exists and both isolated positive and negative exact-head probes satisfy their expected outcomes with bounded evidence.
